notes.title: Nominate The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road for The Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hello and happy Autumn Sale, gamers!

I wanted to take a moment to thank all of you who have played The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road and helped it get to where it is now.  

Beginning today, The Steam Award nominations are open and I wanted to reach out to all of you and ask for your nomination for the Outstanding Visual Style category!  

With each of the areas in the game being their own unique style and theme, I felt like this would be the most fitting category for the game in a year where so many awesome games have been released.

Can I count on you to nominate Tunnels?

Thank you all for the awesome 2024!

notes.title: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road Patch 2.0.1 Patchnotes
notes.notes:
[h2]The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road[/h2]
[h3]Version 2.0.1[/h3]

I just pushed a patch that should address a few bugs that have been reported by a few players.  As always, I do take bug reports seriously so if you experience any bugs, please let me know with as much detail as you can provide in the Bug Report thread in the Steam Discussions page for this game.  This will allow me to keep track of the bugs easier.

Keep in mind some bugs that are reported will require a bit of detail beyond "x bug happened" in order for me to address it.  

[h3]Change Log 10/25/2024[/h3]
[list]
[*] A note has been updated to show the "inspect" icon.  Previously that specific note didn't show any icon at all.
[*] Fixed an issue where an achievement for a later area was being given at the start of the game.
[*] Added onscreen text to the mausoleum doors to better reflect that something needs to be done to open them.
[*] Added the usual visual indicator particles to the pedestal by the angels in the Graveyard to better guide players to inspect it for a clue.
[/list]
[h3]Known Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] A small number of players have reported that in rare instances the cutscene prior to the final encounter will not fade back into the game.  This was an issue that had existed in 2.0 beta builds without fail that was thought fixed.  I'll continue looking into a better solution for this issue however if you experience it, simply exiting to the title screen and picking Continue will put you right where the cutscene leaves off.  I appreciate your patience while I find the root cause and solution to this.
[/list]

notes.title: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road Patch v2.0 Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
The time has finally come.  Patch 2.0 has been released, bringing with it a load of changes, fixes, adjustments and a new chapter to the story as well as multiple endings.

Taking place immediately after the events of the base game, players will explore a 4 new areas.  

Players who have previously completed the game may continue from their last save and once they complete the final area of the base game, they will begin the new content.

Some major changes include the addition of subtitles for major dialog, a new visual indicator to let you know when an enemy is near and a few minor tweaks to existing areas.  For a full list of changes, check out the patch notes!

I'm excited to finally get this update in your hands!

[previewyoutube=jHkEZ2TOOzU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road Patch v2.0
notes.notes:
Patch 2.0 is now available!  Accessing the new content is simple.  Continue from your existing save and complete the final area from v1.0 and the story will continue.

[u][b]Change Log 10/17/2024[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]A second chapter has been added.
[*]Two possible normal endings and a secret ending added.
[*]Some object interaction was blocked due to trigger volumes preventing the players raycast from exiting the volume.  This should be resolved now.
[*]The monster will no longer hear you in the locker if you are moving to get a better view.
[*]The monster's hearing detection has been slightly modified allowing you to hide in a locker and prevent him from walking directly to you.  If he sees you go into the locker however, he will still catch you so keep that in mind.
[*]A new visual indicator for the distance from the player to the monster has been added.
[*]Subtitles added for major dialog.
[*]Radio in hospital now able to be turned off.
[*]Radio in hospital now sounds muffled when not in the same room as it to match the radio in the beginning of the 2nd chapter.
[*]The monster previously did not unload or deactivate as it should upon reaching a point where he is no longer used.  This oversight has been resolved.
[*]Some slight modifications in the 3rd area to discourage brute forcing the combination lock; All of the puzzle pieces are accessible if you are observant of your environment and read the notes for clues.
[*]Previously the game would sometimes appear to be frozen or crashing when loading the next area.  To counter this, I lowered the thread priority for when the game is loading the next area in the background which should smooth out the loading or at the very least make it cause less concern.  
[/list]

[u][b]Known Bugs[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]No known bugs at this time.  Please report them if you find them!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0 Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
I know the news has been slow however I've been hard at work on getting this update finished and I didn't want to rush things.  With that said, I just wanted to give you all a quick update.  

Currently the patch has been handed off to testers so they can double check everything.  

I've gone through the game from top to bottom making adjustments and adding things that I received feedback for as well as things that I thought would make the game more enjoyable for more folks.

Two changes on the list of changes are:
[list]
[*] Subtitles added for major dialog.
[*] Visual indicator for when enemies are nearby.
[/list]

Obviously these are just two things that are being added on top of the new chapter and some adjustments to some mechanical issues that were reported since patch 1.3.6.

I've attached a couple preview photos for the new content below.  Both are older screenshots during the design process but I hope these teasers will get you as excited as I am.

notes.title: A Sneak Peak at Future Content
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, I wanted to share an update with you all.  Firstly, the story for the second chapter of the game is completed minus a few tweaks, proofreading and all that stuff.  While the game in it's current state provided as much details and concluded in the way I initially intended, I've taken some feedback into consideration and aim to provide more story and more answers.  

Currently, work on the updated content is underway and progress is steady.  Design of the first of 4 locations is roughly 50% completed.  That's an arbitrary number plucked from the air though because I will likely keep plucking away at it until I'm happy with it.

With that said, I wanted to share with you all a sneak peak of what is currently completed.  I expect the design of this area should be completed within the next week or two.

If you'd like to follow along with the progress of the development of the game, I will be actively streaming the game's development on Twitch at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/sir_onionknight]https://www.twitch.tv/sir_onionknight[/url].  Feel free support the continued development of this and future games by giving me a follow and hanging out!

As promised, here is your sneak peak of what is to come.  I'll keep you all updated on the progress as I have something newsworthy.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.6 is live
notes.notes:
As you may notice, a new small update was pushed this morning.  

To put it as vague as possible to avoid spoilers, this patch was simply to address an issue in the 2nd area that would unfairly force a player to restart the area after completing all objectives once exiting the area.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone once again for playing The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road.  

I've updated the game to tackle a few of the issues that were reported.  Hopefully the solutions I've come up with resolve some of the game's most common core issues that I was made aware of while watching some playthroughs as well as issues some of you had addressed elsewhere.

Thank you all for your patience.  I will continue to look for ways to improve the game as it is currently while I prepare for the addition of further content for patch 2.0 (date tbd).

[i][u][b]I will address these issues in a way that avoids spoilers to the best of my ability however some cannot be avoided so please do not read on if you want to avoid spoilers.[/b][/u][/i]

[h3]Area 2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you are spotted or heard going into a locker, the monster should now appropriately move to your location instead of get confused and stand in spot.
[*] Previously the monster could in rare cases get stuck on doors.  This should be resolved now.
[*] Starting point for area 2 was rotated 90 degrees the wrong direction.  This should be fixed now.
[*] Increased the minimum range to hear the monster easier when he's close.
[/list] 

[h3]Area 3:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many players were not able to find one of the puzzles needed to acquire a key item due to a lack of visual cues.  I have made that slightly easier.
[*] Previously when restarting at the checkpoint after acquiring the keys, the game failed to show that the safe had been opened already and the keys acquired leading to frustration believing that they had to do the safe combination all over again.  The safe door should now be open upon restarting at that checkpoint.
[*] In addition to the previous issue, the combination to the safe is now saved properly upon completion of the checkpoint and so the X Ray images will show the proper code used to open that safe.  (Note: each time this area is loaded, a new safe combination is generated so if you have not opened the safe and acquired the keys yet, you will still be generated a new combination.)
[/list] 

[h3]General Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Very rare instances where the game crashes when loading the next area should be resolved.  If this persists, please leave a comment in the bug reports thread in the Discussions page for the game with any details you may be able to provide to narrow down the cause.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates In the Pipeline
notes.notes:
Everyone, I just wanted to first take a moment to thank you all for playing Tunnels.  I've seen so many awesome playthroughs on YouTube and Twitch and it feels awesome hearing your feedback.

During the playthroughs, I have noticed a handful of issues which seemed to be overlooked by myself and some testers, likely due to us all having gone through the entire playthrough so much trying to intentionally break things that there were some very basic things we were overlooking.

As always, bug reports are helpful.  If you find a bug, whether it's small or huge and game breaking, please let me know.  The discussions section is a great way to post bugs and I appreciate the feedback I've received there so far and am working to address the feedback.

Two other bugs I'm aware of involves the 2nd area.  Speaking as vague as I can to avoid spoilers, I am aware of an issue involving the lockers and the ladder and will be working toward resolving that.  

All of the currently known bug scenarios seem to require very specific situations to replicate however so bear with me on those while I try to isolate the causes.

Additionally, I'd like to point out that a few folks have managed to skip an entire puzzle to get to the final area, but not before wandering around trying to find what they need.  In the next update, I do intend on making how to access the puzzle more obvious.

As much as I love seeing people complete the game in their own way, I think I have done some folks a disservice by not at least nudging them in the direction they need to go a little more.

Lastly, I've seen a lot of folks speculate on the story.

I understand the ending seems a little abrupt.  Funny enough, the game was always intended to be much shorter and the ending the same but in a dark room with a spotlight.  Since that initial concept, I've expanded the game drastically.

With that said, I do intend on including more story in a future update.  I don't want to provide much more information than that as I don't want to spoil things or promise things that do not happen, but the update will be a free 2.0 update.  No DLC, just additional content for you to enjoy.

So once again, thanks everyone for checking out the game and don't hesitate to let me know of any bugs you encounter.
